coverageThresholdBasis: Metadata-only admission: require nearly all prior-universe symbols per session and at least four fifths of regular decision points. Preserve legacy market-wide minimum3000. No Hybrid or P21 parameter changes.
excludedBoundaryReason: Frozen Hybrid requires open-stamped bars inside [09:00,11:30) or [12:30,15:30); endpoint-only provider records are not regular5m intervals. Report exclusions, never shift timestamps.
missingBars: NO_INTERPOLATION; retain absent intervals and block labels that need them
unknownUniverseSymbols: Report snapshot IPO/delisting risk; do not claim full historicalJPX
timingDiagnostics: signed/absolute return from first observed regular bar open
continuationDiagnostics: MFE divided by absolute observed pre-entry move when nonzero
waitComparison: Paired same-direction hypothetical label at first ABSTAIN versus first laterENTER, complete same-horizon pairs only; descriptive not a causal WAIT-policy effect
clustering: Unequal-size one-way random-effects ANOVA sessionICC on directional return/MFE/MAE; clamp negativeICC only for designEffect; effectiveN=N/(1+((1+CV(clusterSize)^2)*meanClusterSize-1)*max(0,ICC)). Report event and firstENTER separately.
